metadata.name: Tamtaro Complete SEL Setup
metadata.description:
Fully configurable all-in-one setup based on Tamtaro's recommended filters, sort orders, and SELs described on the [GitHub](https://git.tamtaro.de). One template for both Debrid/Usenet or P2P users. 

 * Guides you through API keys, language preferences, optional filters and smart passthroughs during import.
 * Includes optional add-ons and formatter styles. 
 * Uses dynamic SELect Engine to retain the number of streams you choose.
 * Uses auto-synced SELs and & [Vidhin's Regexes](https://github.com/Vidhin05/Releases-Regex) so SEL fixes and updates are received automatically.
 * **ⓘ For catalogs, check out GitHub for AIOMetadata configs.**

inputs.name: Complete SEL Setup v3.2.0: Debrid/Usenet Mode
inputs.description: An advanced filtering & sorting setup powered by Stream Expression Language (SEL) & [Vidhin's Regex Patterns](https://github.com/Vidhin05/Releases-Regex)

inputs.name: Complete SEL Setup v3.2.0: P2P Mode
inputs.description: No services selected. In some countries, torrenting is restricted, so a VPN or a debrid service from previous page may be required.
Language Settings

inputs.name: Required Languages
inputs.description: Select the stream languages you watch. Original, Dual Audio, Multi, Dubbed, and Unknown are automatically added after your selections and are included in the Preferred and Required Language filters. The included formatter displays only your selected preferred languages. A language label is guaranteed to represent the audio language only when accurate media metadata is available; otherwise, it reflects the language identified in the release filename. Use Language Passthrough Options or Sorting Options to further prioritize, pin, or reduce the effect of language preferences.

inputs.name: Strict Language Filtering
inputs.description: Use only the languages selected above in the Required Languages filter. This removes the automatically added Original, Dual Audio, Multi, Dubbed, and Unknown categories. Streams that do not match one of your selected languages are removed. This may exclude valid streams that are tagged only as Dual Audio, Multi, or Unknown.

inputs.name: Preferred Embedded Subtitle Languages
inputs.description: Select your preferred embedded subtitle languages. Subtitle languages will only appear in Formatter if accurate media info is available for that stream (usually from built-in addons, StremThru Torz, Meteor, or Torrentio). You can further prioritize (or disable preference) in 'Language Passthrough Options' and 'Sorting Options'.

inputs.name: Language Passthrough Options
inputs.description: Bypass select language streams from SELect Engine, and optionally pin them to the top. Rest of the results will still follow default SEL setup.

subOptions.description: Language Passthrough Options

subOptions.name: Language Passthrough
subOptions.description: Always include streams in this language when available, bypassing SELect Engine. Matching language streams are exempt from language filter and added to Preferred (to show up in Formatter). Audio-language labels depend on available media info and may be inaccurate when it has not been scraped by StremThru.

subOptions.name: Language Passthrough Amount
subOptions.description: Set how many streams in the selected language can bypass SELect Engine.

subOptions.name: Pin Language Passthrough
subOptions.description: Pin selected language-passthrough streams to the top of the results.

subOptions.name: Anime only
subOptions.description: Apply these language-passthrough settings to anime only. When English is selected, Dual Audio and SeaDex results are included as well.
Subtitle Passthrough Options

subOptions.name: Embedded Subtitle Passthrough
subOptions.description: Always include streams with embedded subtitles in this language when reliable subtitle metadata is available, bypassing SELect Engine. Matching stream is exempt from language filter & added to Preferred (to show up in Formatter). Reliable metadata is commonly available from built-in add-ons, StremThru Torz, Meteor, and Torrentio.

subOptions.name: Subtitle Language Passthrough Amount
subOptions.description: Set how many streams with the selected embedded subtitle language can bypass SELect Engine.

subOptions.name: Pin Subtitle Language Passthrough
subOptions.description: Pin selected subtitle-passthrough streams to the top of the results.

subOptions.name: Anime only
subOptions.description: Apply these subtitle-passthrough settings to anime only.

inputs.description: Add-on Settings

inputs.name: Add-on Preset
inputs.description: Choose between recommended preset (default) or retaining your current addons. The recommended preset includes a base set of add-ons that works for most users, while *None (Use Your Current Addons)* allows you to keep your existing add-on list, catalogs, groups, and dynamic fetching strategy. NOTE: First-time users are encouraged to import the default preset, customize the add-on list afterward, and then select 'None' during subsequent template updates or re-imports to avoid losing customizations.

inputs.name: Preset Modifications
inputs.description: Modify the default add-ons from this template. If *Add-on Preset: None (Use Your Current Addons)* is selected above, this section is ignored.

subOptions.name: Global Timeout
subOptions.description: Enter the time in ms you're willing to wait for results before your add-ons timeout. Default: 5000 ms.

subOptions.name: No Anime
subOptions.description: If selected, anime add-ons will be removed from the add-on list.

subOptions.name: HTTP Addons
subOptions.description: If selected, HTTP streams will be included. Good backup options for niche/older titles, especially if you're without usenet. HTTP Addons are auto-included in P2P Setup.

subOptions.name: Korean Addons
subOptions.description: If selected, yastream will be included. Browsing titles from yastream catalogs will provide direct HTTP streams from kisskh source.

subOptions.name: Debridio
subOptions.description: If selected, [Debridio](https://debridio.com) (Debridio Scraper for Debrid streams) will be added. **Debridio is a paid subscription**. You will need to enter your Debridio API key.

subOptions.name: P2P Addons
subOptions.description: If selected, P2P streams will be included. **P2P torrenting may be restricted in your country, so a VPN may be required to avoid letters from your ISP**.

subOptions.name: Subtitle Add-on Language
subOptions.description: Select the languages for the OpenSubtitles V3+ addon. Select Disabled to remove this add-on from your setup.

inputs.description: Other Settings

inputs.name: Formatter Style
inputs.description: Choose the formatter. **Tamtaro (Full RSE Matched)** keeps all matched Vidhin regex tags in the last line, useful for debugging scores. **Tamtaro (default)** strips audio/video tags from the rseMatched line for a cleaner look. **Minimalist** provides a further stripped-down view, perfect for casual audience. **AppleTV** (inspired by dividedby & stepthomas) fits the 4-line format on tvOS. **Chillio** (inspired by NomadX) fits the wrapping format for Chillio. **Nuvio P2P Instant** Default with removed p2p stream type. **None** retains your existing formatter.

inputs.name: Sorting Options
inputs.description: Default: Cached → SeaDex → Stream Expression → Resolution → Quality → Library → Stream Type → Stream Expression Score → Language → Subtitle → Visual Tag → Audio Tag → Encode → Age → Bitrate → Seeders.

subOptions.name: 1080P Remux Boost
subOptions.description: **Default** prioritizes 1080P Remux streams over 4K Web-DL streams. Default includes other Quality/Resolution rules found inside Preferred Stream Expressions. Set this to **None** to strictly sort by Resolution → Quality (ie., all 4K streams appears before 1080P regardless of Quality).

subOptions.name: Library Boost
subOptions.description: By default, library streams rank first within each Quality/Resolution category, above SEL scores. Boost this if you want your library streams to always be at the top, even if they have lower Quality/Resolution/SEL scores. Useful for identifying episodes from season packs or manually added streams.

subOptions.name: SEL Score Boost
subOptions.description: Priority given to streams with higher SEL scores. Recommendation is default. Boost this if you want to strictly prioritize higher SEL scores regardless of Quality or Resolution.

subOptions.name: Language Boost
subOptions.description: Priority given to streams in your preferred languages. If you struggle to see your preferred languages in the results, try increasing this boost and/or try the Language Passthrough Options for languages. May rank lower-quality streams higher if your preferred languages are uncommon among the results, so use with caution.

subOptions.name: Embedded Subtitle Boost
subOptions.description: Priority given to streams with embedded subtitle of your preferred subtitle languages. This will only affect streams that have accurate media info showing subtitle languages, such as some streams from built-in addons, Stremthru Storz, Meteor, or Torrentio. Check the Language Passthrough Options for subtitle languages if you want to further customize your subtitle preferences.

inputs.name: Sorting Options
inputs.description: Streams are sorted under Global Cached: SeaDex → Stream Expression → Resolution → Quality → Library → Stream Expression Score → Seeders → Language → Subtitle → Visual Tag → Audio Tag → Encode → Age → Bitrate

subOptions.name: 1080P Remux Boost
subOptions.description: Default prioritizes 1080P Remux streams over 4K Web-DL streams. Set this to None to strictly prioritize all 4K streams ahead of 1080P.

subOptions.name: Language Boost
subOptions.description: Priority given to streams in your preferred languages. If you struggle to see your preferred languages in the results, try increasing this boost and/or try the Passthrough Options for languages. May rank lower-quality streams higher if your preferred languages are uncommon among the results, so use with caution.

subOptions.name: Embedded Subtitle Boost
subOptions.description: Priority given to streams with embedded subtitle of your preferred subtitle languages. This will only affect streams that have accurate media info showing subtitle languages, such as some streams from built-in addons, Stremthru Storz, Meteor, or Torrentio. Boost this if you want to prioritize streams with embedded subtitles in your preferred languages. Check the Passthrough Options for subtitle languages if you want to further customize your subtitle preferences.

subOptions.name: SEL Score Boost
subOptions.description: Priority given to streams with higher SEL scores. Recommendation is default. Boost this if you want to strictly prioritize higher SEL scores regardless of Quality or Resolution.

subOptions.name: Seeders Boost
subOptions.description: Boost this if you want highest seeders to always be at the top, even if they have lower Quality/Resolution/SEL scores. In most cases, low seeders will have already been filtered out by SEL.

inputs.description: Advanced SEL Settings

inputs.name: TorBox Tier
inputs.description: Apply a size cap to uncached downloads matching your TorBox subscription tier. Selecting Pro will auto-add Torbox Search (Usenet) functionality to your Meteor's config.

inputs.name: SELect Engine: Debrid·HTTP·P2P
inputs.description: Sets a range of streams kept per Quality/Resolution: your number is the minimum, and up to 1.5× that number may be kept when needed. Default is 3 (usually 3-5 per group, ~15-20 total). Applies to Cached Debrid, HTTP, and P2P streams only. Enter 0 to disable.

inputs.name: SELect Engine: Usenet
inputs.description: Applies the same range logic as above (min = your number, max = number × 1.5 per Quality/Resolution) but exclusively for Usenet results. Default is 3 (usually 3-5 per group, ~15-20 total). Enter 0 to disable.

inputs.name: SELect Refinement
inputs.description: Refine your Final SELection results, such as keeping or removing 720p or Unknown Resolution, Unknown Quality, or Uncached Debrid.

subOptions.description: Refine Final SELection Results

subOptions.name: 720p Resolution
subOptions.description: "Default": Let "Final R SELection" decide. 720p & lower resolutions are kept only when higher resolution results are limited. "Remove": Enforces stricter rule than "Final R SELection", so if at least one known 1080p resolution exists, remove 720p & lower resolutions. "Keep": Bypass "Final R SELection" to keep 720p resolution. Backup streams, library, and SeaDex streams are exempt.

subOptions.name: Unknown Resolution
subOptions.description: "Default": Let "Final R SELection" decide. Unknown resolution is kept when high resolution results are limited. "Remove": Enforces stricter rule than "Final R SELection", so if at least one known resolution exists, remove unknown resolution. "Keep": Bypass "Final R SELection" to keep unknown resolution. Backup streams, library, and SeaDex streams are exempt.

subOptions.name: Unknown Quality
subOptions.description: "Default": Let "Final Q SELection" decide. For movies/series, Unknown Quality is kept when High Quality results are limited. For anime, Unknown Quality is always kept (since many groups don't label Quality). "Remove": Enforces stricter rule than "Final Q SELection", so if at least one known Quality exists, remove Unknown Quality. "Keep": Bypass "Final Q SELection" to keep Unknown Quality. Backup streams, library, and SeaDex streams are exempt.

subOptions.name: Uncached Debrid
subOptions.description: "Default": Let "Final R SELection" decide. Uncached debrid is kept only when no cached results exist. "Remove": Always remove uncached debrid. "Keep": Bypass "Final R SELection" to keep uncached debrid. Streams with zero seeders are still removed by the Low Seeders filter.

inputs.name: Debrid/Usenet Priority
inputs.description: Choose how Debrid and Usenet streams are ordered within the same Quality/Resolution. Merged treats both equally; Usenet First prioritizes Usenet; Debrid First prioritizes Debrid. Other stream types appear afterward.

inputs.name: Pin Options
inputs.description: Pin various top streams to the top for easy navigation, or boost various visual tags to guarantee their inclusion.

subOptions.name: Pin Top Score Per Resolution
subOptions.description: Pin the highest SEL-score stream from each resolution. Supports up to two resolutions.

subOptions.name: Pin Top N per Resolution
subOptions.description: Pin the top N streams from each resolution according to the active sort order. Supports up to two resolutions. To pin Usenet-only results, use the corresponding option under Usenet Options.

subOptions.name: Pin Top N per Quality/Resolution
subOptions.description: Pin the top N streams from each Quality/Resolution group according to the active sort order.

subOptions.name: Visual Tag Passthrough
subOptions.description: Allow up to five streams for each selected visual tag to bypass the SELect Engine. Use this when normal filtering leaves too few streams with your preferred visual format.

subOptions.name: Pin Visual Tags
subOptions.description: Pin visual tag passthrough streams to the top of the results

inputs.name: Usenet Options
inputs.description: Some additional options for Usenet.

subOptions.name: Health-☑ NZB Passthrough
subOptions.description: **☑ NZB Passthrough/Pin**: allows all health-☑ Zyclops/UsenetStreamer/AvailNZB usenet to bypass SELect Engine, optionally pin health-☑ usenet to the top.

subOptions.name: Pin Top Usenet per Quality/Resolution
subOptions.description: Pin the top Usenet streams from each Quality/Resolution group.

subOptions.name: Boost Uncached Usenet - Torbox Only
subOptions.description: Treat uncached Usenet streams from TorBox like cached streams during sorting, instead of placing them in a separate Uncached group. Global-only Sort Order will be used.

inputs.name: Final Filters
inputs.description: Trim your results one last time for a cleaner list. They run after all other SEL filtering has completed.

subOptions.description: Additional Filtering After SELect Engine

subOptions.name: Top Resolution Only
subOptions.description: If more than one 4K stream remains after the SELect Engine, keep only 4K streams and remove lower resolutions. If not, the same check is performed for 1080p and then 720p. Backup streams, library streams, and SeaDex streams are exempt. Note: streams selected by this toggle *will not* be affected by "Top N per" options below.

subOptions.name: Top N per Resolution Only
subOptions.description: Keep only top N streams for each Resolution according to the active sort order. Backup streams, library streams, and SeaDex streams are exempt. Note: Does not work on streams selected by "Top Resolution Only" above.

subOptions.name: Top N per Quality/Resolution Only
subOptions.description: Keep only top N streams for each Quality/Resolution group according to the active sort order. Backup streams, library streams, and SeaDex streams are exempt.  Note: Does not work on streams selected by "Top Resolution Only" above.

subOptions.name: Global Result Limit
subOptions.description: Keep only the top N streams after SEL filtering. This is a global limit that works on *all results*, found inside "Result Limits" basic filter.

inputs.name: Device Specific Exclusions
inputs.description: Some TVs can't play *any DV Bluray (P7)*, *Non-Remux with only DV (P5)*,  *TrueHD* & *DTS* audio, or *AV1 Encode* (Shield TV). Select appropriate exclusions right here, and not inside AIOStreams UI filter because these removals need to happen at specific stage in the SEL filering process to allow various fake/upscaled detection filters to work effectively.

inputs.name: Bitrate Options
inputs.description: Configure low bitrate settings for filtering and sorting.

subOptions.name: Static Bitrate Cap (Mbps)
subOptions.description: Set a maximum bitrate that streams cannot exceed. You may enter a custom value between 1 to 99. Set 100+ to disable this cap (default). See the options below for resolution-based and soft-limit behavior.

subOptions.name: Dynamic Bitrate Cap
subOptions.description: Replace the single bitrate cap with resolution-based limits for greater bandwidth savings. Streams above 80% of your selected cap at 4K, 50% at 1080p, or 30% at 720p are removed.

subOptions.name: Soft Bitrate Cap
subOptions.description: Prioritize streams within the bitrate cap (via boosting SEL Score) instead of removing higher-bitrate streams. Within each Quality/Resolution group, larger files move lower in the list and are retained mainly as backups when fewer lower-bitrate choices exist.

subOptions.name: Sort Low Bitrate First
subOptions.description: Sort streams from lowest to highest bitrate within each Quality/Resolution group. Requires a bitrate cap below 100 Mbps.

inputs.name: Backup Options
inputs.description: Configure backup streams (pinned to the bottom) for when your debrid services are unavailable or when you're on mobile data. These streams are exempt from all subsequent filtering.

subOptions.description: Mobile Backup

subOptions.name: Mobile Backup Bitrate (Mbps)
subOptions.description: Add lower-bitrate backup streams for mobile data or unstable connections. These are pinned below your normal results. Set to 0 to disable. A 2-4 Mbps cap is recommended; a two-hour movie is typically about 1-3.6 GB.

subOptions.name: Mobile Backup Per Resolution
subOptions.description: Number of mobile streams to keep per resolution, matching bitrate threshold above. For example, '2' returns up to 2x 1080p and 2x 720p backup streams, pinned to the bottom. If less than 2 is found, then 480p resolution is also checked. Set to 0 to disable.
HTTP Backup Streams

subOptions.name: HTTP Backup Per Resolution
subOptions.description: Number of HTTP streams to keep per resolution. These are pinned below your normal results, skipping the SELect Engine. Set to 0 to disable.

subOptions.name: HTTP Backup Total
subOptions.description: Total number of HTTP streams to keep. These are pinned below your normal results, skipping the SELect Engine. Set to 0 to disable.
P2P Backup Streams

subOptions.name: P2P Backup Per Resolution
subOptions.description: Number of P2P streams to keep per resolution. These are pinned below your normal results, skipping the SELect Engine. Set to 0 to disable.

subOptions.name: P2P Backup Total
subOptions.description: Total number of P2P streams to keep. These are pinned below your normal results, skipping the SELect Engine. Set to 0 to disable.

inputs.name: Miscellaneous Options
inputs.description: Various options such as Keep SEL Edits, Ignore Inline RSE, Show Statistics & Errors, Digital Release Filter, Add-on Name, and Add-on Logo.

subOptions.name: Keep Custom SEL Edits
subOptions.description: Select this option to prevent custom edits to synced urls SEL or regex from being overwritten. Leave it unchecked to benefit from Vidhin's default SEL scores, which are designed to work well with this template. If enabled, you will need to manually disable any duplicated syncedURL SELs inside synced url ESE.

subOptions.name: Ignore Inline RSE
subOptions.description: Select this option to prevent your additional inline Ranked Stream Expression entries from being overwritten. Vidhin's synced url for RSE will still be imported.

subOptions.name: Show Statistics & Errors
subOptions.description: This option will enable Statistic and Error streams at the bottom for debugging purposes.

subOptions.name: Digital Release Filter
subOptions.description: This option will enable Digital Release Filter. It uses the digital release date from metadata providers to determine when to trigger, so it may not always be accurate.

subOptions.name: Add-on Name
subOptions.description: What to call AIOStreams in Stremio?

subOptions.name: Add-on Logo
subOptions.description: Select a logo for your AIOStreams addon. Custom: Paste direct image URL.

inputs.description: **This template does not include any catalogs**. Many prefer AIOMetadata (separate add-on from AIOStreams), so after you finish importing this template, access [Tamtaro's AIOMetadata guide](https://github.com/Tam-Taro/SEL-Filtering-and-Sorting/tree/main?tab=readme-ov-file#%EF%B8%8F-whats-included-for-aiometadata) to complete your perfect stremio setup.
